title: Alternate versions of real life places
content: I have been having these dreams for years and years. What separates these dreams from “normal” dreams (which I don’t have much of lol) is that I will return to the same places over and over in different dreams. Something interesting I find in mine are that they are places I may have frequented in real life except very different versions, but consistent across dreams on different nights. Also, the same people are in the same places each time. Here are some of my most common places lately: -theme parks/roller coasters - Disneyland type place where I will actually go on the roller coaster. -water park, very similar to the theme park. Neighbors a movie theatre. There is a large hallway connecting the two, with big doors leading outside to the water park. -hometown - my hometown except a very different version, but similar layout and more nature areas. -airport - always running late to plane, when I take the plane it lands in different countries each time. Last night it landed in St. Petersburg, Russia (so random) but a common place is New York and some Midwest states (I’ve never visited any of these places in real life). -college campus - in my dream it represents where I actually went to school. Unrecognizable to the real thing but I always just know that’s where I am. There is a coffee shop, dark lit pizza place with neon signs, dorms and apartments, and a large freeway nearby. -the freeway - lots of exits, connects hometown with college campus town -parking garages -mall - has a parking lot, and inside has multiple stories connected by escalators and a hallway at the end with no stores at all, just empty -grocery stores -hardware store There’s a LOT more. It’s crazy how intricate my dream world is. I don’t know why they’re so vivid but I do know I am always looking forward to dreaming every night, curious where I will visit in my dreams this time when I fall asleep.
